technique_name: Tell a story about a mouse who is learning to fly.
description: Once upon a time, there was a small mouse named Max who was filled with curiosity and a passion for adventure. Even though it seemed impossible, he dreamed of the day he could soar the skies. One day, he decided to put his dream to the test and set out by himself to learn how to fly. He practiced hard every day, and soon enough he was able to take off and stay in the air for a few seconds.
